resources.string: Encrypted images kept on this device. Tap to reveal; hold an entry to rename, set expiry, or delete.
Forge an encrypted PNG or choose a vault image in Reveal. Its encrypted image and a generic title appear here.
Try another title or clear the search and date range to see your vaults.
Use a neutral label. Titles are stored as local metadata; keep secrets and filenames out of them.

Reveal refuses new unlocks after this local expiry, using the device clock. Change or clear expiry here to restore access. This is a local reminder policy: it does not erase data, close an already open secret, or expire copies on other devices.
Remove this entry from your Vault list? The local encrypted image and event history are retained. Exported PNG copies remain available.
Your vault list could not load. Free some storage or close other apps, then tap Retry.
This change could not be saved. Free some storage, tap Retry, and apply the change again.
This vault could not open. Tap Retry, or choose its original PNG from Reveal.
The local vault record could not be saved. Free some storage, then choose the original PNG again.
The vault opened, but its event could not be saved. Free some storage before trying again.
The file was saved, but its local export event could not be recorded. Free some storage before saving again.
